diversity_recomputed.algorithm: existing assign_diversity: median/MAD standardization + scipy.cluster.vq.kmeans2(minit=++, seed=20260901, iter=50)

selection_rules.diversity: Recompute existing diversity algorithm on the 47 visual-pass nominal episodes using initial J1-J6, trajectory shape, duration, grasp timing, release timing, and path length; retain all clusters.
selection_rules.nominal: Retain all 47 manually visual-passed nominal episodes; PASS_A and PASS_B both count as success, including natural correction in PASS_B.
selection_rules.recovery: Retain only manually reviewed RECOVERY PASS episodes; FAIL and AMBIGUOUS are excluded from the first training version.
selection_rules.salvageable: Keep original CLEAN/SALVAGEABLE labels and require explicit H20 mask binding for SALVAGEABLE episodes.
selection_rules.true_bad: Do not re-add the 45 TRUE_BAD nominal episodes.
